name: InfiniteBench
description: A benchmark requiring 100,000+ token contexts for evaluation, testing models on tasks including long-document QA, code debugging over large codebases, retrieval from novels, and math calculation tracking. One of the first benchmarks to require context lengths exceeding 100K tokens, explicitly designed to test models claiming ultra-long context windows.
reputation: Among the first 100K+ token context benchmarks; developed by Tsinghua University and OpenBMB; revealed substantial capability gaps even in models claiming long context support
notes: One of the first benchmarks explicitly requiring 100K+ token contexts. Revealed that GPT-4 and Gemini 1.5 Pro utilize only 5–25% of input context in some tasks (per BABILong research). Tasks include En.QA (English QA over novels), En.MC, Code.Debug, Math.Calc, and retrieval tasks. Published 2024.
